title: A Practical Guide to Vibe Coding: From Wishful Programming to Spec-Driven Development
author: SOM_WHY
summary: What AI coding tools can actually do, and how the intent–spec–implementation loop turns vague wishes into reliable, spec-driven development.

title: Building an Isolated Environment for Pi Coding Agent with Docker Sandbox
author: SOMWHY
summary: A Windows-focused guide to running Pi Coding Agent in Docker Sandbox with isolated tools, network access, and API credentials.
title_zh: 如何用 Docker Sandbox 为 Pi Coding Agent 搭建隔离环境
